Visibility.description:
Who can see a cart without being shared in. Members always see a cart. Visibility only widens that, and only inside the cart's own tree. | | |---| | `private`
Only members: the creator and whoever it is shared with. | | `scope`
Everyone in the cart's own scope, such as its team. | | `boundary`
Everyone inside the cart's boundary, such as its organization. |
